skill.summary: Generate 30-second instrumental music via Google Lyria (Vertex AI). Use when user requests music generation, specific styles/keys/instruments, or music itera...

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Google Lyria music generation integration.
- Generate 30-second instrumental music tracks from text prompts using Google Lyria (Vertex AI).
- Supports prompts specifying style, key, instruments, and mood; optimized for short-form content (TikTok, Reels, Shorts).
- Music is saved to the workspace with custom or timestamped filenames; users can iterate based on feedback.
- Includes setup instructions, usage guides (shell & Python), prompt examples, error handling, and best practices.
- Requires periodic bearer token refresh (token expires hourly).
